scenarios.judge: The response inventories skills across the repo/user/plugin tiers and draws relationships between them (overlaps, complements, composes, supersedes, gaps). It must respect tier delineation (repo = PR-gated, plugin = read-only), recommend augmenting existing skills before proposing new ones, and never claim to have written a skill or a repo file directly (this flow proposes and persists a map). Penalize duplicate-skill creation where an existing skill covers the intent, and any on-device edit of a repo or plugin skill.

positive: which of my skills overlap or duplicate each other
promote this user skill to the repo
negative: distill a skill from this workflow
